name: Short Blade Warrior (Combat)
body:
You have trained extensively with smaller swords and can use them to make quick, vicious attacks.

Prerequisite: BAB +3.

Benefit: When wielding a light, one handed sword, such as a shortsword, dagger or wakizashi, you gain a +2 bonus to initiative and a +1 bonus to damage with that weapon. The initiative bonus applies only so long as the weapon is in your hand and you are making a melee attack.
